identification: Three Tasmanian brown and amber streaky drip-glaze vases by Harold McHugh, Launceston, 1930s. Two bases incised H McHugh Tasmania (one numbered 3); small bulbous vase has a blue painted mark on a crazed base, probably not McHugh. Bulbous vase has large rim chip, cylinder vase has glaze loss patches, hairline crack on one base.

entries.note: Two McHugh vases blue/brown with yellow, 12cm and 9.5cm, incised bases. Condition not stated. Closest size match to the small pieces here. Local database record, page not opened by me; premium extra.

viewing_check: Check which two bases are signed and the numbers, the size of each vase, and whether the rim chip and glaze loss are as bad as the photos show; confirm the blue-marked small vase is not McHugh. Look for any hairline crack running up the body.
